mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate cholinergic effects of rivastigmine and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and CNS toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac status closely; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use; consider dose adjustment of rivastigmine if renal impairment develops.
